long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The flowers are at the meadow and I want to see what is growing there before anyone else does.
Whatever is growing there ought to be sniffed before I decide whether it is mine.
A few flowers would look well on the windowsill, and I am not asking anyone's permission.
Inspecting meadows is tiring, and the bed is the correct place to recover from it.
A patch of sun is where I take my rest once the meadow has been dealt with.
The telescope is the biggest thing here, and I will be at it when dusk comes.

today.reason: The meadow has colour and I have not yet claimed anything in it, so I will look it over properly, then rest, then go to the telescope for dusk.
